--- SOURCE https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/configuration/settings/
--output-format -o Specifies the format of the CLI output for non-interactive mode. text , json , stream-json text : (Default) The standard human-readable output
Possible values: plan (analyze only, do not modify files or execute commands), default (require approval before file edits or shell commands run), auto-edit (automatically approve file edits), auto
